profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Mathematica | Full-Stack Development
profile.summary:
At Mathematica, my focus is on enhancing system scalability and efficiency, having led the transition of legacy systems to AWS. My role involves collaborating with architectural teams to design and implement cutting-edge software solutions, utilizing my proficiency in full-stack development, including React.js.

Our team's efforts in migrating applications to cloud infrastructure have significantly improved operational capabilities. Holding an AWS Cloud Practitioner certification, I am dedicated to harnessing cloud technologies to benefit our clients and advance the company's technological forefront.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: In my role as a Software Engineer at Mathematica, I supported both in-house and external administrative applications, troubleshooting issues and providing solutions. I collaborated with architecture teams to design new software technologies for clients and successfully migrated Legacy applications to AWS, enhancing efficiency and scalability for the company.

positions.title: Applications Analyst
positions.description:
Developed and deployed Microsoft .NET Applications at Sentinel Technologies, enhancing web functionality and mentoring colleagues.

• Led development, configuration, and deployment of Microsoft .NET Applications.
• Designed user-friendly internal website and fixed bugs, improving web functionality.
• Mentored colleagues and integrated apps with REST / SOAP APIs using C#, JavaScript, HTML/CSS.

positions.title: Co-Op Technical
positions.description:
• Developed and tested web-based online forms (XINK) using HTML, JavaScript, and Argonne developed tools for the ESQ Division.
• Collaborated with the Computer & Information System Division to ensure efficient form creation and routing.
• Contributed to enhancing environmental safety and quality assurance processes at Argonne National Laboratory.

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Implemented feature updates for web applications using JSON, JavaScript, improving site functionality and user retention.
